title: Canonical Research Inference Artifact
description: Line-agnostic provenance envelope for any GeoSync research line. Contains zero line-specific fields; research_line identifies the producing line. Anchored on W3C PROV-DM, RO-Crate 1.1 (conformsTo), and the FAIR principles (F1/I2 resolvable identifiers).

conforms_to.description: RO-Crate 1.1 conformsTo: the resolvable $id of the schema this artifact pledges to. A machine can fetch the contract it was validated against.

schema_version.description: SemVer of the artifact schema. Lets consumers detect envelope evolution without guessing.

research_line.description: The research line that produced this artifact (e.g. 'ricci_microstructure', 'cross_asset_kuramoto'). The envelope is line-agnostic; this field is the only line identity.

decision.description: Verification verdict. 'ABSTAIN' (formerly 'NO_TRADE') aligns with the platform's verification-first, non-trading product boundary (PRODUCT_CATEGORY.md). 'OBSERVE'/'REJECT' are the non-evidence decisions.

falsification_status.description: PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED = a falsification battery ran with that verdict. NOT_RUN = nothing computed. NOT_APPLICABLE = a real score was computed on non-empirical (synthetic/instrumented) inputs and no falsification/evidence is claimed; never valid at an empirical claim_tier.

artifact_role.description: Honest self-label. 'placeholder' = illustrative schema example with no real data; never evidence-bearing, never PASS. Absent defaults to 'evidence' for semantic-truth checks.

method_version.description: Version of the computation method that produced score (e.g. 'ricci-ollivier-v1.2'). Required for an evidence-bearing PASS so the result is attributable to a pinned method.

score_source.description: Provenance of score. 'computed' = produced by this repo's pinned method; 'placeholder' = inert, no computation; 'external' = imported result. A PASS requires 'computed'.

baseline.description: Reference to the null/baseline the score is judged against (e.g. a baseline artifact path or null-id). Required for a PASS: a result with no baseline is not falsified, only asserted.

replay_command.description: Exact shell command that recomputes this artifact from committed inputs (data_sha256, config_sha256, git_sha, seed). Deterministic under a pinned environment; the repo's CALIB-GRID F3 result establishes that cross-BLAS bit-identity is not guaranteed, so this field claims recomputation, not cross-environment bit-equality. Required for a PASS: an evidence claim that cannot be replayed is not evidence.

env_sha256.description: sha256 over the canonical environment lock manifest (interpreter version + frozen dependency closure + BLAS/LAPACK identity), computed by tools/provenance/env_digest.py. SLSA Provenance v1 resolvedDependencies; Pineau et al. JMLR 2021 'computing infrastructure'. Required for a PASS: two clean checkouts at the same git_sha can resolve different numeric stacks, so the environment must be pinned for the replay claim to hold.

output_sha256.description: INV-DET1 / Law T6 determinism-kit hash of the full result payload (not the lossy score float). ACM 'Results Reproduced' badge; Pineau et al. JMLR 2021. Required for a PASS so replay verifies REPRODUCTION (same output) rather than mere re-execution.

agent.description: Responsible agent that produced this artifact: 'ci:<workflow>@<40-hex-sha>' | 'local:<hostname>' | 'human:<id>'. PROV-DM wasAttributedTo / SLSA builder.id. Required for a PASS: an evidence claim must be attributable to a responsible runner.
